title: Shrapnel Memory
text: Metal recollection catches whenever the road demands a decision.
flavor: Every route sounds like the shell that put you here.
origin: A navigation core burst and left route fragments embedded along the spine.
burdenText: The first route test each turn suffers -1.
trigger: The first authored route test each turn.

effect.text: Shrapnel Memory recognized the route as hostile.

relief: Purge this Scar at the Sable Machine Choir.
upside: Machine enemies expose familiar weak seams.
